"""
PocketCoffea analysis configuration (pocket-coffea==0.9.13).

Defines categories as the cartesian product of:
  - jet multiplicity (JetGood):    ==4j, ==5j, >=6j
  - b-jet multiplicity (BJetGood): ==2b, >=3b

using MultiCut (per-axis multi-bin cut wrapper) and CartesianSelection
(cartesian combination container) instead of enumerating each of the
3x2 = 6 categories as a standalone Cut.
"""

from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough
from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import ProcessorsABC

localdir = "."

# --- Preselection: require the jet/b-jet collections used below to exist ---
preselection_cut = get_nObj_min(4, coll="JetGood", name="atleast_4j")

# --- Axis 1: jet multiplicity binning on JetGood ---
njet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood", name="4j"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood", name="5j"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood", name="6j"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# --- Axis 2: b-tag multiplicity binning on BJetGood ---
nbjet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood", name="2b"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood", name="3b"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# --- Cartesian combination: 3 (jet bins) x 2 (b-jet bins) = 6 categories ---
categorization = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_multicut, nbjet_multicut],
    common_cats=[passthrough],
)

cfg = Configurator(
    parameters={},
    datasets={
        "jsons": [f"{localdir}/datasets/example_dataset.json"],
        "filter": {
            "samples": ["ExampleSample"],
            "samples_exclude": [],
            "year": [],
        },
    },
    workflow=ProcessorsABC,
    skim=[preselection_cut],
    preselections=[preselection_cut],
    categories=categorization,
    weights={
        "common": {
            "inclusive": ["genWeight", "lumi", "XS"],
            "bycategory": {},
        },
    },
    variations={
        "weights": {"common": {"inclusive": [], "bycategory": {}}},
    },
    variables={},
    columns={},
)
